name: Azure Boards
summary: Azure Boards is the work tracking part of Azure DevOps, with work item states, an Assigned To field, a Priority field and links to commits, pull requests and GitHub objects. The first 5 users are free, then it costs $6 per user per month.

facts.text: In the Agile process a user story moves from New to Active, Resolved and Closed, and most work item types allow transitions both forward and backward.
The Assigned To field names the person responsible, and the Priority field rates a story from 1 to 3 by how essential it is to shipping.
Adding a work item ID such as #35 to a commit message creates a Commit link when the commit is pushed.
Once Azure Boards is connected to a GitHub repository, work items can link to a GitHub branch, commit, issue or pull request.
The Basic plan with Test Plans costs $52 per user per month, with the first 5 users free.

plans.name: Basic
plans.unit: per user per month after the first 5 users
plans.notes: First 5 users free. Includes work item tracking and Kanban boards
